comment: strix claudebox managed settings (R8/D11): auto mode + xhigh effort; CLI currency comes from the DAILY box rebuild, not self-update. The deny list is a BEST-EFFORT guardrail against casual package-discipline drift, not enforcement — prefix rules are reorderable and the in-box user has sudo; the real mechanism is the disposable box + daily rebuild (anything installed ad hoc dies within 24h). No fleet-policy layer (out of scope, D10). Model + ultracode are session-scoped and live in the /usr/bin/claude wrapper (--model default = the recommended alias, never a fixed pin).
